title: Identification of a potential novel biomarker in intervertebral disk degeneration by bioinformatics analysis and experimental validation
summary: ZNF542P was lower in IVDD samples in the separate GEO validation set and positively correlated with γδ T-cell proportions (R=0.54, p=0.0094); the authors propose it as a potential IVDD biomarker. The marker was selected from 22 training samples, checked in a distinct 34-sample GEO validation set (AUC 0.879, 95% CI 0.754–0.972), and examined by qRT-PCR/Western blot in tissue from two patients. The tissue check is narrow; clinical utility remains unestablished.
ai_technology: LASSO logistic regression and SVM-RFE performed feature selection on IVDD gene-expression profiles; their overlap identified candidate characteristic genes for validation.
